summary_1line: Usanas enters Shiva’s body through yogic power, emerges as Sukra after austerities, and Bhishma transitions to teachings on righteousness via Parasara and Janaka.

image_candidates.scene_text: Shiva with blood-red eyes raises his lance in fury while the sage Usanas mystically stands upon the very tip of the weapon.
Shiva opens his mouth and swallows the glowing sage Usanas as the gods look on.
The radiant sage emerges from Shiva’s body while Uma stands between him and the enraged god holding his lifted lance.
